title: Applying an encoded payload
statement: Given an action on $k$ work tapes with Boolean symbols and a singleton state set, and an optional Boolean summary symbol, form an action on $k+2$ work tapes with record states. It copies the input-head movement and the original $k$ work-tape actions; on the first additional tape it makes no write or movement, and on the second it stays in place and writes the summary symbol obtained from the given symbol and the action's output. It emits no output and enters the halting state.
hypotheses_covered: An action on $k$ work tapes with Boolean symbols and singleton states
caveat: The definition of the summary-symbol combination is not included in the supplied material.
